storiesThatMove.name: Nasos Ghavelas
storiesThatMove.role: Two-time Gold Paralympic Champion, Brand Ambassador of SPOTTEQ
storiesThatMove.quote: For me, my own 'spotter', my guide runner on the track, isn’t just someone I run alongside; it’s the person who gives me the confidence to push myself one step further, right when everyone else thinks you’ve reached your limit. With SPOTTEQ, I feel like I have true support at every stage—from the toughest workout to daily recovery—powered by high-quality dietary supplements that deliver immediate results in my day-to-day training.

featuredProducts.title: Featured Products
featuredProducts.description: A focused line of science-driven formulas for strength, performance, recovery and everyday health. Explore all our series, flavours and formats to build the system that works for your body and training.

bundles.title: Our Bundles
bundles.description: Curated combinations of products that work together – for strength, performance, recovery and everyday health. Choose a Performance or Clinical bundle to simplify your routine and get a complete SPOTTEQ system in just one step.

about.description: From the most high-intensity workout to your daily wellness and protection, there is a SPOTTEQ dietary supplement, built on certified raw materials and liposomal technology, designed to push you past your limits. Just like a trusted spotter who is always there for you, even when no one else is.

quality.description: The core principle of SPOTTEQ is to offer premium products, providing a reliable and transparent choice for every athlete. With an emphasis on high bioavailability, easy digestion, and exceptional taste, our products are manufactured under strict international quality standards and are notified to the EOF (National Organization for Medicines), ensuring premium quality and safe consumption.
